slots.jd.residential-hvac.about:
About us and the job
Aspen Ridge Mechanical is an owner-run heating and cooling company serving homes in and around Salt Lake City. We are looking for an HVAC technician to join our field crew. The work is on site in customers' homes, servicing, repairing and installing furnaces, air conditioners and heat pumps. We keep our crew small, treat customers fairly and stand behind our work.
slots.jd.residential-hvac.duties:
What the job involves
- Visit homes to diagnose heating and cooling faults and carry out repairs
- Estimate jobs for customers and explain costs and options in plain terms
- Test systems for refrigerant leaks and repair them to code
- Service furnaces, air conditioners and heat pumps on maintenance visits
- Keep clear work orders and records for each job
slots.jd.residential-hvac.needs:
What you need
- 4 or more years of experience as an HVAC technician
- A current HVAC Technician Licence (required)
- Hands-on skill in heat pump service, system diagnostics and leak testing
- Experience with building automation and thermostat installation
- Brazing and soldering on copper line sets and fittings
- A Controls Technician Certificate is preferred
slots.r1.b1: Keep work orders complete and current on every furnace repair call, cutting billing corrections by 45 percent.
slots.r1.b2: Carry out preventive maintenance visits on heating and cooling systems, using brazing and soldering to repair line sets and fittings found during inspection.
slots.r1.b3: Install furnaces and air conditioners sized from load calculations, reducing callbacks on new installations by 30 percent.
slots.r1.b4: Prepare job estimates for homeowners covering equipment, labour and thermostat installation, and explain each option before work begins.
slots.r1.i1: Handles preventive maintenance visits for Evergreen Climate Services customers, inspecting, cleaning and adjusting heating and cooling equipment.
slots.r1.i2: Tests heating and cooling systems for refrigerant leaks at Evergreen Climate Services and repairs them before returning equipment to service.
slots.r2.b1: Diagnosed heating and cooling faults alongside senior technicians, using leak testing to locate refrigerant losses and cutting repeat visits by 40 percent.
slots.r2.b2: Ran electrical testing on compressors, motors and controls while checking systems for leaks, confirming safe operation before handover.
slots.r2.b3: Kept work orders up to date with readings from building automation systems, reducing missing service records by 45 percent.
slots.r2.b4: Assisted on preventive maintenance visits, checking filters, belts, burners and drains and recording findings for the lead technician.
slots.r2.i1: Tested heating and cooling systems for refrigerant leaks at Tillman Mechanical while training under licensed technicians.
slots.r2.i2: Kept accurate work orders for service calls at Tillman Mechanical while learning heating and cooling repair as an apprentice.
slots.summary.1: Heating and cooling service technician with 4 years of experience completing work to code without supervision. Skilled in furnace repair, electrical testing and building automation, and holds an HVAC Technician Licence.
slots.summary.2: Licensed HVAC technician with about 4 years of field experience, working independently and to code on service and installation calls. Brings hands-on skill in furnace repair, electrical testing and building automation, backed by a Refrigerant Compliance Certificate.
